decisions.reason: One cross-platform static-binary ecosystem and mature HTTP/TLS/streaming support; alternatives add another runtime or system adaptation surface without solving the desktop kernel risk.
decisions.targetGate: IO-01c build/race/contract matrix and three-node cross-build
decisions.replacementTrigger: Supported-platform loss, unstable required OS APIs, or CGO server build failing the reproducibility gate

decisions.reason: A static SPA handles concurrent desktop, transfer, and component state without adding SSR or RSC trust boundaries.
decisions.targetGate: PC-07 locked browser matrix and IO-01c web suite
decisions.replacementTrigger: Maintained-line loss, security advisory, bundle budget failure, or a locked target browser incompatibility

decisions.reason: Only the echova composition root needs the database; mature database/sql integration is preferred and CGO does not spread to endpoint agents.
decisions.targetGate: IO-04a online backup/restore and IO-03b WAL load
decisions.replacementTrigger: Windows agent embedding becomes required, single-writer throughput misses the gate, or multi-instance writes become a requirement

decisions.selected: Tailscale 1.102.3 and tailscale.com v1.102.3 with first-party edge gateway
decisions.reason: The gateway can authenticate the accepted socket peer with LocalAPI while retaining application registration, password sessions, and revocation.
decisions.targetGate: PC-01 and G1 unregistered/revoked/public rejection matrix
decisions.replacementTrigger: LocalAPI, certificate, or Grants behavior cannot satisfy exact destination and least-privilege requirements

decisions.selected: MeshCentral 1.2.5 and exact per-platform MeshAgent hashes; candidate only
decisions.reason: It is the smallest currently plausible browser-control candidate, but its ICE path and URL-token behavior remain explicit G0 elimination risks.
decisions.targetGate: G0: secure desktop, Tailscale-only fail-closed, desktop-only, separate origin without URL credentials
decisions.replacementTrigger: Any G0 condition fails, a long-lived upstream fork is required, or media must relay through echova

decisions.selected: Ordinary-user Go agent with Tailscale HTTPS and target-pull copying
decisions.reason: Direct endpoints preserve user permissions and avoid centralizing file content while allowing one authorization and SafeFS contract.
decisions.targetGate: FF-00 >3 GiB browser streaming/resume and G4 six-direction matrix
decisions.replacementTrigger: A locked browser cannot safely stream/resume with header authorization or handle-based SafeFS cannot be unified

decisions.reason: Retains the user's existing history UI without creating a second clipboard writer or feedback loop.
decisions.targetGate: IO-02 migration, three-component health, propagation matrix, and 24-hour soak
decisions.replacementTrigger: A13, private authentication/rotation, or queue recovery cannot pass

decisions.selected: Docker Engine 29.7.2/Compose on echova plus native systemd and Windows Service agents
decisions.reason: Server dependencies stay isolated while login-screen and user-permission agents retain native OS integration.
decisions.targetGate: IO-04a restore and IO-04b adjacent-version/canary/rollback DAG
decisions.replacementTrigger: Compose cannot safely integrate with host Tailscale/LocalAPI or the rollback gate fails
